title: Space used by the comparison machine
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, choose work-tape indices $fst,snd in k$, let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $k$ work tapes, and let $t$ be a natural number. Starting from the configuration containing those words, the comparison machine visits at most $min(|w(fst)|,|w(snd)|)+2$ distinct cells on each of tapes $fst$ and $snd$ by time $t$. Every tape whose index differs from both $fst$ and $snd$ visits exactly one distinct cell by that time.
hypotheses_covered: $fst,snd$ are indices among the $k$ work tapes
$w$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $k$ work tapes
